prompt_template: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game UI attribute rating badge for a Chinese xianxia ink-and-ivory interface. Exact readable text: "{grade}" only. Single compact rounded diamond seal medallion, ivory inlay with {color} enamel and matching metallic edge, strong dark outline, subtle ink-brush grain. Bold upright Latin capitals, impeccably correct spelling, thick simple strokes with high contrast, letters occupy most of the badge. Same restrained elegant badge family as the other ranks D C B A S SS SSS. Entire badge fills 90 percent of square canvas, perfectly centered, generous intact corners. Optimized for legibility when shown at 36 pixels; no tiny ornament, no thin lettering, no extra text, no watermark, no surrounding scene, no drop shadow extending far outside badge. Genuine transparent background and transparent exterior. Deliver only this single "{grade}" icon.
